==Ingredients==
* 2 jumbo [[Cookbook:Hot_Dog|hot dogs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] ([[Cookbook:Mozzarella|Mozzarella]], [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|Cheddar]], [[Cookbook:Swiss Cheese|Swiss]], or any cheese that melts easily and is not very creamy)
* ⅛ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (30 ml) crushed froot loops (or any equivalent fruity breakfast [[Cookbook:Cereal|cereal]])

==Procedure==
# Cook the hot dogs in any manner; the original recipe used a pan on a stove, but a toaster oven would suffice.
# Once the hot dogs have cooked and split, remove them from the heat.
# Melt the cheese either in the oven or the microwave (microwave works best). Pour the melted cheese on the hot dogs.
# Sprinkle the crushed Froot Loops over the cheese, and let cool.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* This recipe works best when the hot dogs are closer together on the serving plate so that any stray Froot Loops are caught in between.
